column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline scan rules for the DAST job (.github/workflows/dast.yml).
#   action = IGNORE  — accepted / not applicable, never fails the scan
#            WARN     — reported, does not fail the scan (default for anything not listed)
#            FAIL     — reported and fails the scan
#   url-regex — omit (empty 3rd column) to apply to every URL; otherwise a Python
#               regex matched against the finding's URL
# Posture: ADVISORY for now (fail-action: false in dast.yml) — this file is the staging
# ground. As each finding from the first report is judged, add an IGNORE line with a note,
# or fix it. Once the report is clean of un-IGNOREd findings, add the pull_request trigger,
# flip fail-action to true, and add the "DAST baseline" check-run to the branch ruleset.
# (no rules yet — every finding is reported as WARN)
